components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #111111; color: #FFFFFF; padding: 16px 24px; border-radius: 6px; font-family: 'SF Pro Display', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 16px; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1), opacity 120ms; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); opacity: 0.9; }

components.name: Bento Card
components.description: Standard content card, 12px radius with ultra-light border.
components.html:
Coffee Details

components.css: .ds-card { background: #FFFFFF; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid #EAEAEA; padding: 16px; font-family: 'SF Pro Display', sans-serif; } .ds-card-title { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 4px; color: #111111; } .ds-card-body { font-size: 14px; color: #787774; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.css: .ds-chip { background: #F7F6F3; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 6px 16px; font-family: 'SF Pro Display', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.5px; color: #111111; display: inline-block; cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms; } .ds-chip:hover { background: #EAEAEA; }

narrative.overview: Kalpa Coffee is designed to feel slow, crafted, and human. The interface disappears into the experience, acting as a warm, organic extension of the café rather than a screen demanding attention. Utilitarian minimalism drives the layout—high contrast, strict macro-whitespace, bento grids, and flat component architecture—but is softened by patient transitions and tactile responses.
keyCharacteristics: Warmth without nostalgia: Modern restraint combined with a tactile feel.
Craft reveals care: Every typographic decision, spacing rhythm, and color choice communicates intentionality.
Invisible technology: No dark mode, no glaring alerts. Surfaces are quiet.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: The interface avoids loud, saturated colors. Accents are desaturated washed-out pastels. No dark mode is permitted.

rules.name: The Editorial Density Rule
rules.body: Text is never cramped. Ample line height (1.6 for body) and tight letter-spacing (-0.5 to -1.5 for display) maintain a print-like rhythm.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are generally flat. Depth is purely conveyed through border contrast (#EAEAEA) and color blocking, with shadows reserved for gentle layering.

dos: Do use Newsreader for all expressive, large headings.
Do maintain the 6px radius for inputs/buttons and 12px for cards.
Do ensure transitions are patient (300-600ms target) to respect the calm café environment.
donts: Don't introduce generic, saturated brand colors. Stick to the muted palette.
Don't add drop shadows to buttons or inputs.
